directives.directive: Treat commit f813472 as the canonical restore point. Prefer the original first-deployed visual direction; do not reapply the Gemini redesign unless the user explicitly asks for it again.

notes.content: Canonical build prompt is stored in build_prompt.md. Current approved baseline is the cinematic Next.js one-page presentation using App Router, Tailwind, Framer Motion, GSAP, and React Three Fiber.

GitHub remote is git@github.com:XaMiNeZH/The-Digital-Heritage-Vault.git on main. Approved v1 baseline commit is f813472. Vercel production URL used during setup: https://custodix-digital-heritage-vault.vercel.app.
